column3: States a focused question the poster sets out to answer.
column6: The question is stated in one sentence near the top, names a specific population or system, and is narrow enough to answer with the data shown.
column9: The question is stated and specific, but it is broader than the data shown can fully answer.
column12: A topic is named, but it is phrased as a subject area rather than a question, or the reader has to infer the question.
column15: No question can be identified; the poster describes a topic without saying what it investigates.

column3: Supports each claim with data or cited sources.
column6: Every claim is backed by data shown on the poster or a cited source, and each figure is referenced in the text that interprets it.
column9: Most claims are backed by data or citations; one or two claims rely on assertion alone.
column12: Data or citations appear, but several claims are not connected to them, or figures are shown without interpretation.
column15: Claims are made without data or citations, or the data shown does not relate to the claims.

column3: Arranges content so a viewer can follow it in a logical order.
column6: Sections follow a clear reading path (question, method, results, conclusion) with headings, and every figure has a caption and labeled axes.
column9: Sections follow a reading path with headings; one or two figures lack captions or axis labels.
column12: Headings exist, but the reading order is unclear, or several figures lack captions or labels.
column15: No headings or reading path; text and figures are placed without an order the viewer can follow.

column3: Credits sources in a consistent citation style.
column6: All sources are cited in one consistent style, and every in-text citation matches an entry in the reference list.
column9: All sources are cited; there are minor style inconsistencies or one mismatched reference.
column12: Some sources are cited, but the style is inconsistent or several in-text citations have no matching reference.
column15: Sources are used but not cited, or citations cannot be matched to any reference.
